verseText: They replied, “Believe in the Lord Jesus and you will be saved, you and your household.”
meaning: Paul and Silas said these words. They explain how we can be saved. Anyone who believes in Jesus can be saved. It includes you and everyone in your house.

recall.question: What did Paul and Silas say we must do to be saved from sin?

meaning.question: Paul and Silas said that everyone in our household could be saved. What does that mean?
choices: Anyone who believes can be saved
If a dad believes, his whole family is saved
God keeps our houses from falling down

application.prompt: You don't have to be grown up or know everything about the Bible to believe in Jesus. You can trust Him right now! The good news of Jesus is for anyone who believes: moms, dads, brothers, sisters, aunts, uncles... everyone!
